summary: Hills Bancorporation filed an 8-K regarding its wholly-owned subsidiary's Agreement of Purchase and Sale for a 19.2-acre parcel (200/500 ACT Drive, Iowa City, IA) for $20.7 million. The property will consolidate operational teams; headquarters remain in Hills, Iowa. The transaction is a standard real estate acquisition subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions, with closing expected in Q1 2027. No financial terms beyond price or advisor names are provided. This is a routine real estate purchase, not a corporate special situation.
